status: frozen with the v3 protocol, before any final outcome is opened

main_comparison.rule: for each of the two methods and each of mixed_id and mixed_ood: the first success and the first failure by case ID (lexicographic) in that method's final records; every selected case is recorded for BOTH methods (side by side on the identical case). If a method has no failure in a condition, that is stated and no substitute failure is chosen.

severe_noise.rule: first noise_4mm case by ID (shows the effect of unfiltered noise)

giver_reference_comparison.rule: first mixed_ood case by ID on which the two final outcomes differ; if none differ, the first mixed_ood case

montage: all clips in the order above, 20 Hz control, real-time playback, captions with run/case/method/seed/checkpoint
processes: one recording process per estimator configuration and observation shape (protocol file); evaluation and replay outcomes are both kept, and a disagreement is disclosed
